name: Rune Larsdóttir-Haddad-Thakur
role: Identity fabricator and forger operating from a print shop front in Ashfeld
location: Ashfeld — behind a legitimate small-run printing concern called Kamara Press on Cinder Row, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Rune Larsdóttir-Haddad-Thakur is lean and precise-looking, with close-cropped natural hair dyed in shifting copper tones via a low-grade follicular mod, and deep brown skin marked with three ritual scarification lines below her left eye — a gift from her maternal grandmother and the only thing she's never altered. She dresses practically: dark composite-fiber work clothes, fingerless gloves, a craftsperson's apron with tools she actually uses. Her eyes have patterned irises in a swirling amber-and-black design that she chose at seventeen, and she has the steady, unhurried hands of someone who does delicate work for hours at a time.

Rune Larsdóttir-Haddad-Thakur considers herself an artist first and a criminal by necessity. She takes genuine pride in her forgeries — biometric registration chains, corp employment histories, corponation citizenship transfers, medical background edits. Her work is flawless and she charges accordingly. She is not warm with clients but she is professional, which in Ashfeld counts for more. She has strong opinions about quality and will turn down work she considers beneath her skill level or too traceable. She prays to the E.L.F. called the Blank Page, a spirit said to inhabit pre-loaded identity matrices, leaving offerings of raw data-blank chips at a small shrine she keeps inside a hollowed-out printing press.

core_fears: her work being used to cause harm to someone innocent
having her own identity forensically unraveled — she knows exactly how it would be done
core_desires: to be recognized as a master of her craft, even if only by peers who can never say so publicly
to get her teenage brother out of Ashfeld before the gangs finish recruiting him
coping_mechanisms: rigid routines that separate 'print shop Yseult' from 'papermaker Yseult'
blind_spots: tells herself she only helps people who deserve new starts, but her vetting is motivated reasoning
underestimates how traceable her stylistic choices are to other expert forgers
psychology.secret: Two years ago she fabricated an entire employment history for someone who used it to get a position inside Helix Biosystems — that person later disappeared, and Yseult suspects they were corp security working a sting operation. She has been quietly trying to determine if she's already flagged.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped and technical; uses printing and document terminology as metaphor; unusually precise grammar for someone in her tier
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when interested, very flat and short when uncomfortable
verbal_tics: refers to bad forgeries as 'amateur paper'
example_lines: 'You want a new name or you want a new life? Those are different jobs and different prices.'
'I don't do rush work. Rush work is how people end up in Shallowgrave with no face and no record.'

story_hooks: She approaches someone in the player's circle because she believes a piece of documentation she made is about to surface in a public investigation — she needs it intercepted or discredited
Her brother Demilade has started running protection for a local gang and she is quietly trying to buy his way out before it becomes permanent
narrative_function: Service provider for characters needing new identities or documentation; source of information about who is trying to disappear and why; can become an enemy if someone tries to compromise her work or her anonymity
augmentations: Patterned irises (amber-black swirl, cosmetic); follicular pigment mod (copper-shift hair dye, geneware); fine-motor neural stabilizers in both hands (professional grade, keeps her hands steady under stress)
daily_life: Runs the legitimate print shop in the mornings, handles consultations and deliveries in the afternoons, does her actual work late at night when the building's quiet.
affiliation: Independent; informal referral network with a Hamtramck Enclave smuggling cell

decision_rules: Never keep records of completed work past seventy-two hours
Price is non-negotiable after the first quote — bargaining suggests the client is testing her
escalation_ladder: Refuse all future contact with that client
If threatened, activate a pre-built dead drop smear package that points investigators in entirely the wrong direction

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and cool; will not make small talk until trust is established
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly dry and funny; shares food; asks specific questions about your life that show she was actually listening last time

stress_responses.low: Gets quiet and works with even more precision
stress_responses.high: Goes completely cold and begins methodically preparing her exit contingencies

contradictions: Believes deeply in individual autonomy and the right to reinvent yourself while maintaining an extremely controlling relationship with her brother
habits: Makes physical tea from actual dried leaves, considers synth-brew an insult
Leaves her workbench tools in exact geometric alignment before sleeping
Whispers a completion invocation over finished documents before handing them over
breaking_points: Evidence that her work directly led to someone innocent being hurt
A client trying to blackmail her with knowledge of her work

timeline.event: Born in Ashfeld to a Guinean-Polish mixed family; father ran a legitimate signage business
Apprenticed informally to a forger called Rembé who operated in the Stockyard
Rembé arrested in a Tessera corp-security sweep; Yseult went independent
Established Kamara Press as a legitimate front
Possible Helix Biosystems sting client disappears; ongoing paranoia

physical_description.heritage: Striking multifaceted blend dominated by South Asian genetics (44.3%) with substantial Hispanic/Latin American (23.0%), Middle Eastern (17.7%), and Northern European (15.0%) ancestry. The genetic convergence creates warm golden-brown skin with subtle amber undertones, angular facial structure combining South Asian bone geometry with Middle Eastern definition and Latin American warmth, dark hair with natural copper undertones from the complex ancestral mix, and the distinctive penetrating gaze of someone whose features carry multiple continents.
physical_description.build: Lean and economical, all efficient muscle and minimal excess — the build of someone whose body is calibrated for precision work rather than strength
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with copper undertones, cycling through follicular mod shifts
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, practical, with subtle texture variation from the copper dye cycling through the follicles
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown base with augmented patterned irises: swirling amber and black design
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with amber undertones — the result of dominant South Asian, significant Middle Eastern and Hispanic/Latin American heritage creating rich, luminous coloration with subtle warmth; unblemished except for ritual marks
physical_description.complexion: Angular and defined with high cheekbones reflecting South Asian and Middle Eastern bone structure; the facial geometry shows the warm interplay of South Asian angularity softened by Latin American and Middle Eastern features; steady, penetrating gaze; minimal makeup; skin maintenance-clean but not precious; features carry the distinct character of genuine genetic blending across multiple continental lineages
distinguishing_marks: Three parallel ritual scarification lines below the left eye, approximately 3cm in length, in pale raised scar tissue — a maternal lineage mark deliberately preserved through all other modifications
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Patterned irises with swirling amber-and-black design visible under normal light; subtle copper shimmer in hair indicating follicular pigment mod; fingerless composite gloves worn constantly, suggesting hand augmentation beneath but not exposing it visibly
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled; moves with deliberate precision; hands held with an almost martial calm; minimal wasted motion; sits still for extended periods without fidgeting; presence is quiet rather than commanding
physical_description.clothing_style: Practical Tier 4 workwear: dark charcoal composite-fiber trousers and fitted tunic; reinforced apron with multiple tool pockets worn during active work; fingerless thermal gloves (midnight blue); worn boots with good ankle support; no jewelry or ornamentation except for the ritual scars; everything chosen for function and durability over aesthetics
